description:
At PointClickCare our mission is simple: to help providers deliver exceptional care. And that starts with our people. As a leading health tech company that’s founder-led and privately held, we empower our employees to push boundaries, innovate, and shape the future of healthcare.
 
With the largest long-term and post-acute care dataset and a Marketplace of 400+ integrated partners, our platform serves over 30,000 provider organizations, making a real difference in millions of lives. We also reinvest a significant percentage of our revenue back into research and development, ensuring our employees have the resources to innovate and make a lasting impact. Recognized by Forbes as a top private cloud company and honored as one of Canada’s Most Admired Corporate Cultures, we offer flexibility, growth opportunities, and meaningful work. 
 
At PointClickCare, we empower our people to be the architects of a smarter healthcare future; one that is human-first and accelerated by AI to create meaningful and lasting change. Employees harness AI as a catalyst for creativity, productivity, and thoughtful decision-making. By integrating AI tools into our daily workflows, collaboration is enhanced, outcomes are improved, and every team member has the proficiency to maximize their impact. It all starts with our hiring practices where we uncover AI expertise that complements our mission, and we continue to invest in training and development to nurture innovation throughout the employee journey.
 
Join us in redefining healthcare — so it doesn’t just survive, it thrives. To learn more about PointClickCare, check out Life at PointClickCare and connect with us on Glassdoor and LinkedIn.
 
 
**Travel to Office expectations**
For Remote Roles: If this role is remote, there will be in-office events that will require travel to and from the Mississauga and/or Salt Lake City office. These will include, but not limited to, onboarding, team events, semi-annual and annual team meetings.
 
For Hybrid Roles: If this role is Hybrid, there will be an expectation to reside within commutable distance to the office/location specified in the job listing. This will include, but not limited to, weekly/bi-weekly/monthly events in the office with your specific team. This is a requirement for this role.

Team Summary:

Strategy & Corporate Development is a small team that partners directly with PointClickCare’s Executive Team to decide where the company plays and how it wins over the next 3 – 5 years. This team owns the full arc from insight generation to stakeholder alignment—shaping long-range strategy and financial planning; tracking market, competitive, and regulatory shifts across long-term and post-acute care; sizing our highest-impact new growth opportunities; and deciding whether to build, buy, or partner to capture these opportunities. When the answer is buy, the same team sources, evaluates, negotiates, and closes relevant transactions (M&A, joint ventures), setting them up for successful integration and performance against underwriting theses. This is a small, but high-impact team with consistent opportunities for driving impactful decisions and meaningful senior leadership-level exposure.
 
The team operates in a hybrid model, with most roles based in Toronto and a few remote across the US, consisting of one SVP, two Directors, one Senior Manager, one Manager, and one Senior Analyst.
 

Job Summary:

As PointClickCare approaches $1 billion in ARR, ensuring the whole company aligns behind a clear, coherent strategy becomes ever more critical.
 
The Strategy & Corporate Development Director leads enterprise-level strategy initiatives that shape PointClickCare’s long-term growth agenda, portfolio priorities, and investment decisions. The Director independently frames complex and ambiguous strategic questions, integrates perspectives across end-markets and functions, and develops recommendations for the Executive Team and Board. As a strategic thought partner to the SVP, Strategy & Corporate Development, the Director leads major components of long-range and annual planning, drives alignment on enterprise priorities, and provides direction and quality oversight to other team members supporting strategic initiatives.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the identification, stack-ranking prioritization, and provide recommendations to the organization around our highest-potential growth opportunities that support the company’s aspirations through whitespace analyses, market inventory and pricing outlooks, and assessment of how customers’ business models are evolving
  • Lead strategic assessments of market, customer, competitive, and regulatory developments. Synthesize and frame major, future-weighted headwinds and tailwinds into clear hypotheses, supported by proprietary intelligence, advising the Executive Team on the “What? So What? Now What?”
  • Lead major components of PointClickCare’s enterprise strategic planning process, translating long-term strategic priorities into financial assumptions, enterprise objectives, investment requirements, and measurable performance indicators. Integrate inputs across end-markets and functions, challenge inconsistent assumptions, and escalate material risks, gaps, and trade-offs for Executive Team decision.
  • Formulate, refine, and cascade our play-to-win strategy across all end-markets to the organization, ensuring senior leadership buy-in on where the company will play, how it will win, and what it will deprioritize, and establish mechanisms to monitor execution against agreed strategic priorities.
  • Contribute to and inform portfolio management and capital allocation decisions, including building the case for major organic and inorganic investments, evaluating M&A and joint ventures, and assessing divestitures and wind-downs. Develop and present investment recommendations, articulate financial and strategic trade-offs, challenge underlying assumptions, and advise senior leadership on whether and how PointClickCare should proceed.
  • Coach and mentor junior team members, providing guidance and feedback that strengthens strategic thinking, analytical rigor, executive communication, and independent judgment.

    • Required Skills & Experience:

  • 7+ years of experience at a top management consulting firm, private equity, investment bank, or in-house strategy experience at a scaled, sponsor-backed business
  • Successful track record leading or contributing to evaluation of expansion in existing and new segments, including market entry options for new businesses, go-to-market strategy for new product offerings, and build-buy-partner assessments
  • Demonstrated qualitative (market research, synthesis, hypothesis development) and quantitative (Excel, financial modeling) analytical skills 
  • Strong financial acumen and ability to understand core business levers
  • Exceptional communicator, able to convey complex ideas in a clear, concise manner both verbally and in writing
  • Self-starter who thrives and can manage multiple workstreams in fast-paced environments

    • Preferred Experience:

  • Familiarity with the US healthcare system
  • Exposure to SaaS and HCIT business models and metrics 
  • Experience working directly with Executive Teams, Boards, and investors
